    Description

    Ancient Grains Chicken Recipe for Whole-Body Wellness

    This thoughtfully crafted recipe pairs high-quality chicken and turkey with nutrient-dense ancient grains to create balanced nutrition that supports your dog from the inside out. Packed with protein, fiber, omegas, and functional ingredients, it’s designed to fuel healthy digestion, joint support, skin and coat health, and everyday vitality.

    Protein-Rich with Real Chicken and Turkey

    Chicken and chicken meal provide highly digestible protein, while turkey meal adds additional amino acids to help support:

    • Strong, lean muscles

    • Healthy energy levels

    • Ideal body condition

    With added salmon oil, cod liver oil, flaxseed, and chia, this recipe naturally supports skin, coat, and overall wellness.

    The Power of Ancient Grains

    Sorghum, millet, and quinoa are ancient grains rich in fiber, antioxidants, and essential nutrients. They provide steady energy and gentle digestion without unnecessary fillers, helping your dog feel satisfied and supported throughout the day.

    Natural Joint Support for Active Dogs

    Chicken cartilage provides a natural source of glucosamine and chondroitin to help support joint health and mobility, especially important for growing puppies, active adults, and aging dogs alike.

    Gut Health from the Inside Out

    A healthy digestive system supports everything else.

    With inulin prebiotic fiber and a blend of probiotics including Lactobacillus and Bacillus strains, this recipe helps support:

    • Digestive balance

    • Nutrient absorption

    • Immune function

    Functional Ingredients with Purpose

    This recipe includes a variety of real ingredients chosen to support whole-body wellness:

    • Pumpkin, spinach, cranberries, blueberries, tomatoes, and beets for antioxidants

    • Apple cider vinegar, turmeric, kelp, and chamomile for natural support

    • Taurine and essential vitamins and minerals for heart health and vitality

    Skin, Coat, and Heart Health Support

    Omega fatty acids, taurine, and key nutrients work together to help maintain:

    • A healthy, shiny coat

    • Comfortable skin

    • Strong heart function

    • Long-term vitality

    Complete and Balanced for All Life Stages

    Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for All Life Stages, including the growth of large size dogs (70 lbs or more as an adult).

    Dependable, purposeful nutrition you can feel good about feeding from puppyhood through the senior years.

    How much do I need?

    4 lb bag contains ~12.75 cups
    22 lb bag contains ~70.5 cups

    A 22 lb bag will feed a 40 lb dog for about a month (~31 days). 

    Ingredients

    Chicken, Chicken Meal, Grain Sorghum, Millet, Turkey Meal, Chicken Fat (preserved with Mixed Tocopherols), Whole Ground Flaxseed, Coconut Meal, Quinoa, Natural Flavors, Salmon Oil, Potassium Chloride, Chia Seed, Chicken Cartilage (source of natural chondroitin sulfate and glucosamine), Sea Salt, Apple Cider Vinegar, Cod Liver Oil, Kelp Meal, Choline Chloride, Calcium Carbonate, Dried Beet, Dried Cranberries, Dried Pumpkin, Dried Spinach, Dried Tomatoes, Inulin, Dried Blueberries, Dried Chamomile, Diatomaceous Earth, Dried Turmeric, Zinc Amino Acid Complex, Vitamin E Supplement, Iron Amino Acid Complex, Copper Amino Acid Complex, Vitamin A Supplement, Manganese Amino Acid Complex, Thiamine Mononitrate, Calcium Pantothenate, Riboflavin Supplement, Pyridoxine Hydrochloride, Manganous Oxide, Biotin, Vitamin B12 Supplement, Vitamin D3 Supplement, Ethylenediamine Dihydroiodide, Folic Acid, Sodium Selenite, Calcium Iodate, Rosemary Extract, Taurine, Dried Lactobacillus acidophilus fermentation product, Dried Lactobacillus casei fermentation product, Dried Bifidobacterium thermophilum fermentation product, Dried Enterococcus faecium fermentation product

    Muenster Ancient Grains Recipe with Chicken Dog Food is formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO (Association of American Feed Control Officials) Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages including growth of large size dogs (70 lb. or more as an adult).

    Feeding Guidelines

    For Adults

    Dog Weight (lbs) Cups Per Day
    Up to 10 ¼ - 1
    10 - 20 1 - 1½
    20 - 40 1½ - 2¼
    40 - 60 2¼ - 3
    60 - 80 3 - 3¾
    80 - 100 3¾ - 4½
    Over 100 4½ + ¼ cup per additional 10 lbs

    All Life Stages:

    All of our dog food products are great for furry family members of any age. When feeding one of our quality dog foods, we recommend you begin with the suggestions provided here and adjust to maintain body weight. We recommend feeding your dog at least twice per day. The feeding chart shown is the total amount of food we recommend for the day. Divide the total by the number of feedings you will provide your dog.

    Growth:

    Introduce dry food around the 5th week and provide as much food as puppies will consume from weaning till full grown.Reproduction:Provide increasing amounts of food the latter half of gestation. The amount may be twice the normal intake. Feed to consumption during lactation.Hydration:Always provide a source of clean fresh water.

    My Custom Dog Food Enhancements

    • SALMON OIL

      Adds Omega-3s to support healthy joints, better cognitive function AND shiny coats!

    • Probiotics

      Delivering millions of probiotics for immune and digestion support to keep your dog’s gut healthy.

    • Beef Bone Broth

      Add to help with digestive, skin and joint health. Create a bone broth around the kibble by adding warm water!

    • Bacon Fat

      Delivers an irresistible flavor for picky dogs and added fat for dogs that have trouble keeping weight on.

    • MCT Oil

      Full of Omega-3 & Omega-9, our customers say it's been helping dogs with seizures, cognitive decline & poor skin health!!

    • Dried Salmon

      A high quality protein loaded with Omega-3s to support your dog’s immune system and maintain a healthy skin and coat.

    • Beef Liver

      Adds iron, A and B vitamins, additional protein and healthy fats, AND extra flavor for pickier dogs.

    • Goat's Milk

      Hundreds of millions of probiotics to support your dog's immune system, digestion, and nutrient absorption.

    • Freeze-Dried Beef

      Add vitamin packed, nutrient dense beef organ meat that your dog craves to the outside of their kibble.

    • Dried Cheese

      High in protein and calcium, not to mention flavor, dried cheese supports healthy teeth and bones.

    • Freeze-Dried Chicken

      Add vitamin packed, nutrient dense chicken organ meat that your dog craves to the outside of their kibble.

    • Freeze-Dried Elk

      Add vitamin packed, nutrient dense elk/venison organ meat that your dog craves to the outside of their kibble.
